about.heading: Craftsmanship built around your home
paragraphs: MM Projects is a Glasgow-based home improvement and property renovation business. We fit kitchens, renovate bathrooms and create bespoke joinery, fitted wardrobes, flooring and doors for homes across Glasgow and the surrounding areas.

Every project starts with a conversation. We take time to understand how you use your space, visit to measure up, and give you a clear quotation before any work begins. On site, we focus on tidy, careful workmanship and the finishing details that make a renovation feel right.
